pillar_reactions.evidence: Internal call between closer and setter. No pillars presented and no prospect present.

unmet_demand.want: Written plan and pricing options before committing to a sales call — relayed second-hand on this call from a lead named Bo Reid, not from anyone present
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The stated company position is that no such thing exists: the setter told him 'we don't have a standard menu of plans. It's all custom and the call is the best way to figure out what the right setup is rather than sending something generic.' The transcripts in this batch contradict that, showing repeatable tiers at $6,000 for six months, $4,000 for three, $3,000 with Caden, $1,000 for six months of self-study and $200 a month. So the demand is refused rather than unserved. This is the third instance of the same demand in this batch — Edward Garcia asked to see what the programme actually is and was told 'there is not much more', and Omar demanded a breakdown before spending $6,000 — which makes it a pattern rather than an outlier.
